scope: Diagnose and repair the LibreCAD_3 PR #456 arm64 Homebrew runtime-dependency metadata mismatch without weakening validation of copied native libraries.

source.head: 7e81275b71038d4a42fa580842e661ddcee7adbf
source.publicationReview: Automatic review rejected the GitHub content upload: it would publish a large potentially sensitive internal implementation plan, and conversation history was not accepted as authorization for that disclosure. Review explicitly prohibits retry through another route.

finding.cause: Homebrew's installed runtime_dependencies receipt table is mutable package-level metadata, not the Mach-O runtime load graph. Treating its dependency rows as keg-resolution instructions rejected a retained zstd bottle when Homebrew's current lz4 receipt differed.
finding.runtimeClosure: RuntimeStager resolves and traverses actual LC_LOAD_DYLIB edges. Each selected source copied into the bundle is independently checked for Homebrew bottle, source version, architecture, exact origin and original-byte digest before mutation.
finding.policy: Schema-check both retained and installed dependency tables, but do not resolve package-level rows as loaded binaries. Keep exact original bottle, archive/cache and actual loaded-source checks fail-closed.

changes: Removed selected_dependency_receipt validation of package-level dependency rows.
Retained strict dependency-table schema and identity-shape validation for both original and installed tables.
Updated regression coverage to permit post-pour table changes while checking malformed table refusal.
Added a direct control that an actual loaded dependency with a source-built receipt is refused independently.
Added direct RuntimeStager coverage proving actual-load-source capture occurs before byte-identical copying and source-built load rejection leaves no staged destination.

planSync.worktreeCoverage: python3 scripts/validate_python_binding_plan.py --worktree --exclude-path build.log --exclude-path configure.log --exclude-path tests.log: PASS; the test and plan paths map to all 12 required gates, no unmapped paths or stale validated evidence

validation.hostedCI: not rerun; local candidate 1a012ff6 has not yet been pushed

limitations: Fixture tests do not reproduce the hosted zstd/lz4 installation or prove a complete native macOS app bundle.
Intel remains blocked because the current Homebrew runner has no bottles for requested formulas with --force-bottle.
No DWG/DXF interoperability or platform support claim is promoted.
next: Obtain explicit user approval for uploading the implementation plan to the existing PR repository, as required by the automatic review; then publish local candidate 1a012ff6 and wait for hosted arm64 evidence.
Resolve the x86_64 binary-provider/runner policy without silently source-building dependencies.
